title: JailExemption
description: A time-boxed waiver of the jail policy that applies to one repository. It applies after aggregation: the verdict still reports the observed value, the threshold, that the rule would have breached, and which exemption suppressed it. Removing the document deactivates the exemption; the record of what was waived, by whom and why is kept.

repository.description: The repository waived. The exemption attaches to the jail policy in force for it: its per-repository policy, or the tenant default. Apply fails when no policy applies.

rule.description: The label of the rule waived, in the policy in force for the repository. Leave it out to waive every rule in that policy.

reason.description: Why. At least 8 characters once trimmed: an exemption with no explanation cannot be told apart from the policy having been weakened.

expires.description: When the exemption lapses. Left out, it lapses 30 days after it is applied. The server caps it at 365 days after apply: a permanent waiver is a policy change and belongs in the JailPolicy.
